rivalSharingPanel.title: Allow rivals to see segment summaries
rivalSharingPanel.loadError: Could not load the sharing settings
rivalSharingPanel.enabled: Segment summaries are now allowed for your rivals.
rivalSharingPanel.disabled: Segment summary sharing is turned off.
rivalSharingPanel.label: Allow only players who are rivals with each other to compare their plays with mine segment by segment
rivalSharingPanel.description: When on, and only if I have a player as a rival and that player has me as a rival too, they can receive the EX, BP and note count of each segment of one of my plays on the same song and read it with their own AI key. Nothing is sent when only one side has registered the other. Judgement, timing and lane of each note are never sent. When off, only the public judgement totals are compared. It is off by default.

danPanel.title: Dan
danPanel.loadError: Could not load the Dan ranks
danPanel.intro: When you clear a course, the server checks the record and awards the Dan automatically. Other players see only the Dan you choose below for each system, on your profile and in rankings. Only you can see the list of Dan you have earned.
danPanel.noneAcquired: You have not earned any Dan yet. They are added automatically when you clear a course. You can find the courses that award Dan in the <link>course list</link>.

rules.cleared: Plays that finished the course with gauge remaining (FAILED is excluded; ASSIST and LIGHT ASSIST lamps give an A-Dan).
rules.stages: Every stage must be played with the songs listed in the course.
rules.constraints: The course constraints must be followed (MIRROR and RANDOM limits, LN type).
rules.exclusions: Plays that do not enter the ranking for a reason other than assist, such as an untrusted build, are excluded.
rules.assisted: Plays cleared with SCRATCH AUTO, ASSIST, LIGHT ASSIST or a widened judge are recorded separately as an A-Dan (for example A-十段). In automatic display only the regular Dan is shown when it is the same or higher, and both are shown when the A-Dan is higher.
rules.stageRecords: Only plays from clients that also send the stage records are counted. Earlier records are not applied retroactively.
rules.gaugeMode: The gauge mode (LR2, BEATORAJA, IIDX) does not matter. The record is kept either way.

danSystemCard.displayAuto: Automatic (the highest Dan, plus the A-Dan when it is higher)
danSystemCard.caption: Dan earned in {system}
danSystemCard.changed: The displayed Dan has been changed

modelPicker.unverifiedNote: A model marked as having unverified structured-output support means the provider does not report, model by model, whether it supports structured output. If a call fails, choose another model.

usagePanel.title: AI usage and settings
usagePanel.loadError: Could not load the AI usage
usagePanel.footnote: Totals are in UTC. The daily call count starts over at UTC midnight (9:00 AM in Korea) and the monthly tokens start over at the beginning of the UTC month. Calls are counted every time a request is sent to the provider, failed calls included, and are not counted when a saved result is shown again. The monthly token limit is checked against the total before a call, so the last call may go slightly over the limit.

userSettingForm.providerDescription: AI features are called with this provider's key and model. You can only choose from the keys you have registered.
userSettingForm.limitPlaceholder: Leave blank for the operator default
userSettingForm.limitDescription: The sum of input tokens and output tokens. When blank, the operator default applies, and a value you enter takes priority.
userSettingForm.limitError: Enter a whole number from 1 to {max}.
userSettingForm.saved: The AI settings have been saved.
